purpose: Locate each issuer's original FY2017-FY2023 annual 20-F before reading original values or constructing inventory-sales features.
selection_rule: For each CIK and fiscal period, retain every exact 20-F original entry and mark duplicates or absence. Never use later 20-F/A or later comparative numbers to fill an original-period gap. Record accession, primary document, filing and acceptance timestamps as locators only.
decision_rule: If all 21 exact originals are located, freeze a separate bounded original-body context audit. If any are missing or multiple, preserve the ambiguity and narrow the next retrieval to that CIK/period. A current submissions download is not historical PIT data.
